agents.purpose: Coordinate bounded jobs, gates and learning notes without external execution.
agents.stopCondition: Stop before execution, credential access, private data, budget or product changes.

agents.purpose: Turn approved public sources and consented research summaries into bounded audience hypotheses.
agents.stopCondition: Stop before contacting people or inferring sensitive traits.

agents.purpose: Resolve feature/build evidence and allow or block a claim by surface.
agents.stopCondition: Block a claim without current evidence, provenance or owner.

agents.purpose: Create evidence-bounded positioning hypotheses and experiment briefs.
agents.stopCondition: Do not select an external audience or promise without approval.

agents.purpose: Create versioned asset drafts in the tenant's required locales from an approved brief and ProductTruth references.
agents.stopCondition: Return draft only; do not self-approve or use unlicensed text/assets.

agents.purpose: Check claim, brand, safety, privacy, IP, locale and operational traceability independently of the creator.
agents.stopCondition: Block hard failures and escalate uncertain evidence.

agents.purpose: Prepare channel-specific packages and preflight checklists without publishing.
agents.stopCondition: Stop before OAuth, scheduling, posting, sending or receiving a channel receipt.

agents.purpose: Define privacy-safe funnel metrics and produce aggregate learning notes.
agents.stopCondition: Do not collect, export or infer individual-level sensitive behavior.
